T4.rule: each margin's lower bound must clear its own bar (ADR-046)

nlp_first_run_before_rule_update.note: First scoring of the held-out paraphrase bank, run on the test units at 20:3x UTC on 2026-09-28 before the targets were locked and before the extraction rules were extended from the development templates. The T18 bar (>= 0.80 offline) had been drafted before this run and was not changed. Only aggregate scores were viewed; no held-out text or failure was inspected.

pilot.protocol: fit on training draws 0-299; evaluate on held-out training draws 300-399

pilot2.protocol: pilot split: symptomatic units simulated from their own seed stream with the test protocol; never test data

independent_check.method: points above 50 V recomputed from the raw training simulations (meter reading and unloaded node)

script_threshold.rule: lowest effort to a confirmed answer among thresholds within 1 point of the script's best top-1 (pilot, test-mix weights)

twin_tuning.rule: lowest effort to a confirmed answer within 1 point of the best top-1 (ADR-046)

vision.protocol: exact match = normalised display text, unit and mode all correct; no answer counts as wrong; 95 % CI from 2000 bootstrap resamples. The offline reader was developed on synthetic sets with seeds [20260928, 7, 20260929]; the pilot set (seed 20261001) was scored before the targets were locked; T19 is judged on the test set (seed 20261028), scored only after the lock. Every reading is confirmed by the technician before it is recorded.
